runs.content: ICF International (ICFI) picked up at the previous close ($84.12) — re-rated down on a federal-budget-driven Q1 revenue miss despite reaffirmed FY26 guidance, trading at ~11.6-12.1x forward earnings with consistent buybacks. No exits today despite a broad market rally (S&P +1.79%, Nasdaq +2.59%): no position breached the −15% stop, hit a new T1/T2, or tripped the Burry signal-exit rule; FICO slid to −14.82% (just above its −15% stop) and RIVN improved slightly to −10.62%, both WATCH with no Burry conflict. Portfolio net P&L: +$599 (+1.33% on $45,000).

Realty Income (O) picked up at the previous close ($63.87) — Morningstar flagged it 9% undervalued (FV $72) on Jul 29, and today brought a fresh Fitch 'A' credit rating plus raised FY26 AFFO guidance and a 135th consecutive dividend increase. No exits today: no position breached the −15% stop, hit a new T1/T2, or tripped the Burry signal-exit rule; RIVN crossed −11.41% but carries no Burry conflict so it's a WATCH, not an exit. Portfolio net P&L: +$411 (+0.93% on $44,000).
